host_call.method: GLOBAL_ALLOWED_TOOLS and GLOBAL_WITHHELD_TOOLS imported from electron/remote/assistant/HostCallRuntime.ts at this commit. What a call can name is the relayed surface of the same Tool set narrowed to `admits`: the host still applies its tier, ownership and drive rule.

notes: Root tools the dispatch guard admits but tools/list does not carry: host.call, host.list, host.settings. They are absent from the viewless help base manifest (generated mcpExternalBaseManifest + mcpViewlessBaseManifest) this session is listed from, so a client that calls only listed tools cannot reach them at this commit.
